description: Source code for SubscriptionHandler class managing subscriptions, publishing data, and handling threading in a server context for Kuksa VSS. Implements subscription management, data publishing, and thread control.

classes.name: SubscriptionHandler
classes.description: Manages subscriptions, data publishing, and threading for server-side VSS data updates.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Creates a new subscription for a given channel, database, path, and attribute.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Removes a subscription by its ID.

methods.name: unsubscribeAll
methods.description: Removes all subscriptions associated with a given channel.

methods.name: publishForVSSPath
methods.description: Publishes data for a specific VSS path and notifies all subscribers.

methods.name: subThreadRunner
methods.description: Thread function that processes buffered subscription data and sends updates via WebSocket or gRPC.

methods.name: isThreadRunning
methods.description: Checks if the thread is currently running.
